messages:
Maya D: Heads-up: drafting a lightweight client-facing one-pager called 'QuickPatch priming guidance' for accounts stuck in onboarding. Goal = a simple explanation + AM pasteable checklist (caching, batching, streaming) and explicit renewal trigger.
Ravi K: Keep the customer text non-technical: what we did, why it helps, and how to tell us if something feels off. For AMs include commands and thresholds.
Jordan F: Internal ops bullets to include:
- Seed: send 3 tiny synthetic prompts spaced 1s apart to warm model and KV.
- Edge cache: set short TTL (20m) for templated responses; key by tenant+route.
- Fallbacks: route to smaller model when 95p latency or error rate spikes for 3m.
- Batch safety: conservative start (max_batch=10, max_wait=40ms).
Maya D: Pasteable AM snippet for support threads:
"Hi <Name>, we've enabled a brief warm-up and short-term caching to speed up first responses. Reply if you still see slow responses and we'll schedule a 15-min tune."
Ravi K: Pasteable internal checks (single line each):
"cs-tool check <TENANT_ID> --metrics=first_token,kv_miss"
"curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d '{\"model\":\"rwd-mini\",\"prompt\":\"warmup: hi\"}'"
Jordan F: Streaming UX notes: send a small ack chunk immediately; on flaky connections prefer chunked streaming. Reconnect strategy: exponential backoff starting 1s, cap 45s.
Maya D: Renewal trigger (explicit): flag renewal risk and notify RevOps if ANY: onboarding_completion < 60% after 7 days OR avg_first_week_latency > 1.4s OR >2 user-visible timeouts in 72h. Include that exact logic so AMs can automate alerts.
cs-bot: Stub saved at https://redwood.internal/cs/quickpatch-priming (edit final doc there).
Ravi K: Action items: Jordan = add dashboard tiles for priming_hit_rate and kv_miss; Maya = write the 1-pager and AM snippet; I'll draft the automation rule for the renewal trigger.
Jordan F: I will run a small pilot tonight and post before/after numbers (p50/p95/p99 latency).
Maya D: Thanks! I'll share the one-pager tomorrow and drop the pasteable snippets in #cs-templates.
